He carried it to the kitchen, spread it beneath the lamp, and read a girl’s handwriting: tell the lightkeeper the ship is safe. Outside, the beam turned slowly above him, and the sea said nothing.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市还浸在深蓝色的梦里。高楼熄去大半灯火，只剩街灯沿着湿漉漉的马路蜿蜒，像一串疲倦的星。便利店玻璃门透出暖黄光芒，夜班店员打着哈欠整理货架；远处桥头，清扫车缓缓驶过，刷出带水痕的节拍。江风穿过楼群，送来轮渡低鸣。有人刚走出写字楼，围巾遮住半张脸；也有人推开窗，望见天边一线青白。城市尚未醒来，而那些未眠的心事，正悄悄藏进薄雾。","w03":"- Recursion is when a problem asks a smaller, easier copy of itself for help.\n- The smaller copy asks another even smaller copy until it reaches a simple stopping case.\n- Then every small answer gets passed back up, one copy at a time, to solve the original problem."}
